topic: Introduction to AHCP kit, contents of kit and their applicability on aircraft.

specific_objectives: 6.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to perform rectification of corrosion.

practical: Demonstration of AHCP kit contents, identification of corrosion types, and application of rectification materials on test panels.

Documentation of maintenance actions
